scenes.narration: Because it isn't there to walk. It's built to simulate astronaut conditions and give data on life-support systems.

scenes.narration: Gaganyaan G1 is targeted for Q4 2026, with no fixed date yet, riding HLVM3, the human-rated LVM3, from Sriharikota.

scenes.narration: To get here, the capsule was dropped from a helicopter, from 3 to 4 km up, to test its parachutes, after thousands of ground tests.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real shot of a helicopter high in the sky above a descending capsule under parachutes, vertical 9:16, real footage look.

scenes.narration: The goals: test the rocket, the orbital module, re-entry and crew module recovery, with a planned splashdown in the Bay of Bengal.
